authority.receipt: content digest over branch ID, baseline/candidate identities, checkpoint byte digests, exact state diff, and nested Burn verification receipt
authority.promotion: explicit call to commitBranchByReceipt; the branch-set permits one promotion
authority.origin: no input-origin signature or durable host ledger is added by this API

checkpoint.required_state: exact stateful bytes and matching caller-supplied structural identity and SHA-256
checkpoint.fork: each branch transaction imports the same validated checkpoint into its own isolated registry

lifecycle: construct CheckpointBranchSet from live registry and graph plus expected identity and checkpoint digest
fork unique bounded branch IDs from the immutable baseline checkpoint
edit branches with replace/insert/remove/reconnect, output selection, or flat weight updates
stageBranch compiles an isolated candidate; failure leaves the live registry and sibling branches untouched
stateDiff reports exact checkpoint-bundle byte differences and digests
verifyBranch runs the existing Burn baseline/candidate test vectors and binds output comparison plus state diff to branch ID
commitBranchByReceipt promotes one equivalent branch only when caller authorization and the unchanged baseline are supplied

state_diff.meaning: byte-level diff of the complete stateful ProgramBundle, including plan, structural identity, initialization records and layer state
state_diff.ranges: ordered differing byte spans with before/after span digests; at most 64 spans, with ranges_truncated when more exist
state_diff.limit: byte equality/difference does not establish semantic state equivalence

receipt.branch_id: bound into the outer receipt digest
receipt.output: nested baseline-candidate verification receipt includes each tested output shape, digest and tolerance result
receipt.negative_result: mismatch produces equivalent:false and cannot be promoted

limits.branch_id: 1..=64 ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore or hyphen
limits.external_input_contract: port declarations and slot count remain fixed within every branch
